title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: annual aggregate still available on a cover
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line measures the annual aggregate still available on a cover when a claim on it is approved for settlement, for a product whose annual aggregate limit is above 0.00.

## Rule

1. The aggregate still available on the cover is the product's annual aggregate limit less the amounts of the settlement approvals already booked on the same cover whose approval date lies fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the approval date. It is never below 0.00.
2. The annual aggregate is kept per cover, not per cover holder. Settlements approved on the holder's other covers of the product do not reduce it.

## Hypothetical worked example

Hypothetical figures: an annual aggregate limit of 50,000.00 USD, and an approval dated 15 March 2026 on the cover.

| Earlier approval | On which cover | Approval date | Fewer than 12 whole calendar months before 15 March 2026? | Counts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20,000.00 | Same cover | 20 April 2025 | Yes (10 whole months) | Yes |
| 15,000.00 | Same cover | 15 March 2025 | No (exactly 12 whole months) | No |
| 9,000.00 | Same cover | 10 January 2025 | No (14 whole months) | No |
| 30,000.00 | The holder's other cover of the same product | 1 February 2026 | Yes | No (another cover) |

The aggregate still available is 50,000.00 less 20,000.00, which is 30,000.00 USD.

If the approvals that count came to 55,000.00 USD, the aggregate still available would be 0.00, not a negative figure.

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* the holder's approvals on all its covers of the product are pooled. *Correct basis:* only approvals on the same cover count.
